meta.title: Optimize RPKI origin validation performance by filtering VRPs by ASN first
meta.body_summary: Optimize RPKI origin validation performance in rpkiv.rov by first filtering VRPs by ASN to reduce search space, with caching and early termination to improve speed while maintaining RFC 6483 compliance.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot attempted RPKI ROV optimization with ASN-first filtering but violated RFC 6483; after revert and caching attempt, maintainer found cache and test issues, leading to inactivity closure.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 343 changed lines across 2 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. It fits a focused performance optimization PR that was closed due to unresolved correctness and test concerns despite multiple agent iterations.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer tomhrr pointed out that filtering VRPs by ASN first violates RFC 6483 because all VRPs intersecting the announced prefix must be considered regardless of ASN; subsequent caching attempt had issues with global variable misuse and lacked proper RPKI tests.
review_details.performance_claim: Reordering filters (ASN first) reduces search space and improves performance dramatically, with VRP caching and early termination further speeding up repeated validations.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer requested changes to comply with RFC 6483 and to add proper tests; after multiple agent attempts, the PR was closed without resolving all review comments.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Domain-specific RPKI RFC compliance and Charity language constructs (global variable vs function) presented challenges that Copilot could not fully resolve; maintainer required correct understanding of prefix intersection semantics and proper caching implementation.

detection_detail.code_reading: tomhrr reviewed the code inline, identified RFC non-compliance, variable misuse, and requested proper tests; also identified that the prefix intersection comment was inaccurate.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes a small test case with numeric claim but no reproducible benchmark or profiler data; maintainer did not run performance tests but focused on correctness.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After multiple agent attempts failed to satisfy review, the PR was closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: In lib/rpkiv.ch, originally reordered VRP filtering to check ASN before prefix intersection; after maintainer objection, reverted to original RFC-compliant order and added caching via _rpkiv.get-vrps-cached, early termination logic, and a quick prefix check; also touched tests/tests.rs with unrelated tests replaced by basic RPKI import tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test changes were ultimately reduced to syntax checks after maintainer rejected arithmetic tests and requested real RPKI tests, which were not fully implemented.
change_trajectory: Initial commit with ASN-first filtering optimization.
Maintainer pointed out RFC 6483 violation requiring prefix-intersection-first filtering.
Agent reverted to original compliant algorithm in commit a95a544.
Maintainer asked for performance improvement while staying compliant.
Agent added caching, early termination, and quick prefix check in commit e2759c2.
Maintainer reviewed inline: cache storage function/variable confusion, incorrect clear-cache, prefix comment inaccuracy, and irrelevant tests.
Agent addressed some feedback in commit a75f7cc but tests remained basic.

review_signals.summary: All VRPs intersecting prefix must be considered, not just matching ASN; request to adjust to RFC.
After revert, asked to still make function faster.
review_signals.action_taken: Agent implemented caching and early termination.

review_signals.summary: Function named _rpkiv.vrp-cache-storage clashes with later global variable usage; suggest just global variable.
review_signals.action_taken: Agent changed to global variable per suggestion.

review_signals.summary: rpkiv.clear-cache line drops empty hash instead of storing; suggest using global variable assignment.
Comment says finds all VRPs whose prefix intersects, but it finds prefixes equal or larger; request clarification.
Test functions contain arithmetic unrelated to RPKI; request real RPKI validation tests.
review_signals.action_taken: Agent replaced with basic RPKI import tests, but not full validation.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with ASN-first filtering.
Maintainer tomhrr objected within ~5h, citing RFC 6483.
Agent reverted to compliant algorithm after multiple retry prompts.
Maintainer asked for performance improvement while compliant.
Agent added caching and early termination; maintainer found several bugs and test issues via inline review.
Agent attempted fixes but tests remained insufficient; PR eventually closed without merge after inactivity.
